reason: Only a horse ridden by unnamed Aesir to Yggdrasil/Bifrost; c05 explicitly says nothing else is known. No distinguishing anatomy, magical action or attribute can separate Gisl from ordinary horse/rider. Name meanings c04/c08 cannot justify radiant body or powers.
rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.
artistic_choices: Decline before generation rather than add undocumented anatomy or power.
